# ManifestIntent

`schemas/records/manifest-intent.json`

The first ContextManifest event (docs/design/m0/10 "ContextManifest: three append-only events"), committed before egress as part of the call's effect intent. Controller-supplied context comes only from the declared inputs: every input is named exactly once, either included or omitted (cuts are never silent). internal/knowledge checks the cross-field rules.
